title: Page 7
content_zh:
「这样想想，其实我们俩还满笨的耶！」她俏皮地微吐舌尖。「以为只要塞住那四个保镳的嘴，出了燕云山就没人会知道这件事，结果呢，大伯父在我们成亲后不久就派人送信给大哥，告诉他这个喜讯。」
想想也是，这种天大的事情怎么可能不通知呢，他们俩还真的是欠缺思考，以为这么做就能顺利瞒天过海，简直是天真过了头。
「大哥还说，等你醒来之后，他就准备好好臭骂你一顿，说你敢做不敢当，娶了妻子又想当作没发生过这件事，戚家的脸都快被你给丢尽了。」
说着说着，燕晓苗倒是自己轻笑起来。「怎么办，这样你到底是早点醒好，还是干脆拖久一点再醒来？我舍不得你被大哥骂，这样我会难过的……」
她真的会难过，可不是说笑的，如果到时候大哥骂他骂不够，还打算罚他的话，她可是会心疼死了，才不想他受到这样的折磨。
不过不要紧，如果真有这种事情发生，她会跟着他一起受罚，她不会让他一个人的……
一个人自言自语似乎有点无聊，燕晓苗只好开始把玩起戚无雍的手指，一根换过一根，左手玩完再换右手，每一根都不放过。
「啊，我差点忘了，今天还没帮你梳头。」
放下他的手，燕晓苗去拿梳子过来，又坐在床边，轻勾起他一缕发丝，慢慢梳着，就怕太过用力会拉疼他。
「无雍，你的头发似乎变长了一点，你有感觉到吗？」
躺在床上的戚无雍，表情平静，看不出有任何的喜怒哀乐，像是睡得非常熟一样，就连燕晓苗这样聒噪地频频在他耳边说话，还是吵不醒他，她爱梳头他也就任由她梳。或许，他很喜欢她温柔的帮他梳头的感觉，所以他才会选择继续沉睡，让她能够一直帮他梳着，一天又过一天……
手上梳理的动作一直没停，燕晓苗继续柔声低喃着：「舒服吗？还是会痛？如果弄疼你的话，记得要告诉我，别憋在心底都不说，知道吗……」
第8章(2)
叩叩——
就在这时，有人轻敲房门，停顿一会儿之后就主动开门进来。「四弟妹，四弟今天的状况如何了？」
「三哥？」燕晓苗放下梳子，有些没奈何地笑着。「他很讨厌，故意不理我，像是在和我闹脾气一样。」
「喔喔，是了，他小时候是很任性，连我们已逝的爹娘都奈何不了他……」将刚煎好的药拿到床前，戚无秋顺手交给她。「四弟妹，小心烫，我来扶四弟起身吧。」
「嗯。」燕晓苗接过药碗。
戚无秋将戚无雍扶起，让他靠躺在自己胸前，好方便燕晓苗喂药。
「无雍，要吃药了。」努力将匙内的药汁给吹凉，燕晓苗还不忘威胁道：「这次你可别再耍任性，不肯吃药，到时不只其他人笑你，连我都想笑你，没想到你这么大一个人了，一碰上吃药，反应也和小孩子一样。」

默默听着燕晓苗对着戚无雍喃喃自语，戚无秋感到内心有点毛毛的，只觉得这个四弟妹似乎越来越……令人担心。
戚无雍已经沉睡十天，她也这样自言自语过了十天，「症状」一天比一天还要严重，她不哭，只会灿烂地笑，面对其他人时感觉还很正常，独独面对戚无雍时，她会反常得吓人。
就像现在一样，一直讲一直讲，不管戚无雍到底有没有回应，那种感觉有点像是……走火入魔！
真是糟糕！戚无秋真的很担心，要是四弟真的永远醒不来的话，四弟妹该不会就这样继续走火入魔下去，之后就没得救了？
「嗯咳咳……」轻咳几声打断燕晓苗对戚无雍的柔声叮咛，戚无秋试着开口：「四弟妹，照顾了这么多天，我想你也应该非常非常非常疲累了，要不要跟三哥换手，等你休息几天之后再来接手？」
「三哥，我并不觉得累呀！」燕晓苗甜甜地对戚无秋笑着。「我还非常非常非常非常的有精神呢，倒是大哥二哥三哥都有自己的事业要忙，只有我没事做，照顾无雍的事当然就由我来全权负责。」
戚无秋轻叹一声，只好把话给挑明了。「四弟妹，大家都很希望四弟能够顺利醒来，但……你也要有心理准备，或许他最终还是……」
「三哥，你别分心，帮我把无雍给扶好。」
她像是没听到戚无秋在说些什么，甜着笑容催促道：「我得赶紧帮他把药给喂完，要不然药凉了效果就会减少一半的。」
戚无秋彻底没辙，只能任由燕晓苗的「症状」继续走火入魔下去，直叹造化弄人呀……
房外莺声脆啼，春光灿烂，温暖的阳光晒得人们心情舒爽，花草也茂密的滋长着。
「无雍，你快点瞧瞧……」
兴冲冲将一疋鲜红色的上好锦缎拿到房中，缎面上绣的是成双成对的凤凰，燕晓苗开心地对戚无雍说：「你觉得这布疋好不好看？好漂亮……我在燕云山从没见过这么漂亮的布疋……」
将锦缎微微摊开在床边，燕晓苗喜孜孜地继续说话：「你知道这布疋要做什么的吗？呵……我想你绝对猜不出来，还是我好心一点告诉你吧。」
「大哥说，等你醒来之后，要重新帮我们俩办一次婚礼，让全京城的人都知道我们的婚事，大哥还说一定会办得风风光光的，让我嫁得非常有面子。」
床上的戚无雍并没有回话，但沉睡的表情像是在微笑一样，这让燕晓苗越说越起劲，相信他是有听到的。
「就因为这样，二哥特地从布庄拿来这块布，说是要帮我做一件华丽绝伦的嫁衣，虽然我很喜欢，但我想……还是先问问你的感觉再来做决定。」
摸着锦缎上的绣样，她的眼中出现期待的神采，开始幻想自己穿上这件嫁衣的时候，绝对是全天下最幸福、最美丽的新娘子，无雍一定也会惊艳不已的。
好希望那一天能够赶紧到来，她已经有种迫不及待的感觉了……
「话说回来……无雍，你到底觉得好不好、适不适合我，也给点意见吧？」

等了好一会儿，戚无雍还是没有任何反应，但燕晓苗总觉得，他脸上的笑意似乎又浓了一些，像是在同意她说的话，也认为这疋锦缎非常适合她。
「你也觉得很好看，是吧？」
这下子燕晓苗更是开心不已，珍惜的将锦缎给抱在怀中。「所以你要赶紧好起来，才能见到我再穿一次大红嫁衣嫁给你，别让我等太久喔。」
站在门外，听着燕晓苗在里头对着戚无雍自言自语，戚无烟的表情忍不住一沈再沈，也和戚无秋一样心中感到有些毛毛的。
幸好现在是大白天，要不然戚无烟会以为里头有鬼在和她对话呢，之前听三弟形容她很会自言自语时他还觉得应该没这么夸张吧，结果今天一听……
岂止夸张，简直要吓坏人啦！
「呃？二哥，你怎么会站在门外？」
就在戚无烟暗自心惊之际，燕晓苗突然
他赶紧整整神色，表情平淡的开口：「我……我打算回布庄了，所以顺道过来问问四弟妹，觉得这疋锦缎好吗？」
「好呀，我和无雍都很喜欢呢！」
「……」
「二哥，这布疋就麻烦你了。」
将锦缎塞回戚无秋手中，燕晓苗洋溢着幸福甜蜜的笑容。「我很期待嫁衣做出来的那一刻，不知道什么时候会好？」
content_en:
"Think about it this way, we are actually quite stupid!" She playfully stuck out the tip of her tongue. "I thought that as long as the mouths of the four bodyguards were shut, no one would know about it outside Yanyun Mountain. But as it turned out, my eldest uncle sent a letter to my eldest brother shortly after we got married, telling him the good news."
Thinking about it, how could such a big thing not be notified? The two of them really lacked thinking and thought that they could hide it smoothly. They were simply too naive.
"The eldest brother also said that when you wake up, he is going to scold you, telling you whether you dare to do it or not. After marrying a wife, he wants to pretend that this never happened. You will almost bring shame to the Qi family."
As she spoke, Yan Xiaomiao chuckled to herself. "What should I do? Should you wake up earlier, or wait a little longer? I don't want you to be scolded by your elder brother, it will make me sad..."
She would really be sad, no joke. If the eldest brother didn't scold him enough and planned to punish him, she would be heartbroken, and she didn't want him to be tortured like this.
But it doesn't matter, if this happens, she will be punished with him, she will not let him be alone...
Talking to himself seemed a bit boring, so Yan Xiaomiao had no choice but to start playing with Qi Wuyong's fingers, switching them one by one. After playing with his left hand, he switched to his right hand, not sparing each one.
"Ah, I almost forgot, I haven't combed your hair today."
Putting down his hand, Yan Xiaomiao went to get a comb, then sat on the edge of the bed, gently picked up a strand of his hair, and combed it slowly, fearing that too much force would hurt him.
"Wuyong, your hair seems to be a little longer, do you feel it?"
Qi Wuyong, who was lying on the bed, had a calm expression, without showing any emotion or joy, as if he was sleeping very soundly. Even though Yan Xiaomiao kept talking noisily in his ear, she still couldn't wake him up. If she liked to comb her hair, he would let her do it. Perhaps, he liked the feeling of her gently combing his hair, so he chose to continue sleeping so that she could keep combing his hair, day after day...
The combing motion of her hands never stopped, and Yan Xiaomiao continued to murmur softly: "Is it comfortable? Or does it still hurt? If it hurts you, remember to tell me, don't hold it in your heart and not say it, you know..."
Chapter 8(2)
Knock knock——
At this moment, someone knocked on the door. After a pause, he opened the door and came in. "Fourth brother and sister, how is fourth brother doing today?"
"Third brother?" Yan Xiaomiao put down her comb and smiled helplessly. "He was very annoying and ignored me on purpose, as if he was having a tantrum with me."
"Oh, yes, he was very willful when he was young. Even our deceased parents couldn't do anything to him..." Qi Wuqiu handed the freshly cooked medicine to her bed. "Fourth brother and sister, be careful of the burn. Let me help the fourth brother get up."
"Yeah." Yan Xiaomiao took the medicine bowl.
Qi Wuqiu helped Qi Wuyong up and let him lie on his chest so that Yan Xiaomiao could give medicine easily.
"Wu Yong, it's time to take the medicine." Yan Xiaomiao tried her best to cool down the concoction in the spoon, but Yan Xiaomiao did not forget to threaten: "Don't be willful this time and refuse to take the medicine. Not only will other people laugh at you, but I also want to laugh at you. I didn't expect that you are such an old person, and you will react like a child when it comes to taking medicine."
Silently listening to Yan Xiaomiao muttering to Qi Wuyong, Qi Wuqiu felt a little fussy inside, and felt that this fourth younger brother and sister seemed more and more... worrying.
Qi Wuyong has been sleeping for ten days, and she has been talking to herself like this for ten days. The "symptoms" are getting worse day by day. She doesn't cry, she only smiles brightly. When facing other people, she feels normal. When facing Qi Wuyong alone, she will be abnormal and scary.
Just like now, he keeps talking, no matter whether Qi Wuyong responds or not, it feels a bit like... going crazy!How bad! Qi Wuqiu is really worried. If the fourth brother really never wakes up, will the fourth brother and sister continue to be obsessed with it, and there will be no salvation in the future?
"Hmm, cough..." A few coughs interrupted Yan Xiaomiao's gentle instructions to Qi Wuyong. Qi Wuqiu tried to speak: "Fourth brother and sister, after taking care of you for so many days, I think you must be very, very, very tired. Do you want to change hands with the third brother and wait for you to rest for a few days before taking over?"
"Third brother, I don't feel tired at all!" Yan Xiaomiao smiled sweetly at Qi Wuqiu. "I am very, very, very energetic. However, the eldest, second, and third brothers all have their own careers to be busy with. I am the only one with nothing to do. Of course, I am solely responsible for taking care of Wuyong."
Qi Wuqiu sighed softly and had no choice but to clarify his words. "Fourth brother and sister, everyone hopes that the fourth brother can wake up smoothly, but... you must also be mentally prepared, maybe he will eventually..."
"Third brother, don't be distracted and help me hold Wuyong back."
She seemed not to have heard what Qi Wuqiu was saying, and urged with a sweet smile: "I have to help him finish feeding the medicine quickly, otherwise the effect of the medicine will be reduced by half when it gets cold."
Qi Wuqiu had no choice but to let Yan Xiaomiao's "symptoms" continue to go crazy, sighing that fate was playing tricks on people...
The orioles are chirping outside the house, the spring is bright, the warm sunshine makes people feel comfortable, and the flowers and plants are growing densely.
"Wuyong, hurry up and take a look..."
Excitedly, she brought a piece of bright red fine brocade to the room. The satin was embroidered with pairs of phoenixes. Yan Xiaomiao happily said to Qi Wuyong, "Do you think this brocade is good-looking? It's so beautiful... I've never seen such a beautiful brocade in Yanyun Mountain..."
Spreading the brocade slightly beside the bed, Yan Xiaomiao continued to talk happily: "Do you know what this cloth is for? Ha... I don't think you can guess it, so I'll tell you out of kindness."
"Big brother said that when you wake up, you will organize a new wedding for us two, so that everyone in the capital will know about our marriage. Big brother also said that it will be a glorious event and let me marry with great honor."
Qi Wuyong on the bed did not reply, but his sleeping expression seemed to be smiling, which made Yan Xiaomiao talk more and more enthusiastically, believing that he had heard it.
"Because of this, the second brother brought this piece of cloth from the cloth shop and said that he would help me make a gorgeous wedding dress. Although I like it very much, I think... I'd better ask you how you feel before making a decision."
Touching the embroidery on the brocade, a look of anticipation appeared in her eyes, and she began to imagine that when she put on this wedding dress, she would definitely be the happiest and most beautiful bride in the world, and Wuyong would be amazed.
She really hopes that day can come soon, she already feels like she can't wait...
"Speaking of which...Wuyong, do you think it's good or not? Is it suitable for me? Can you give me your opinion?"
After waiting for a long time, Qi Wuyong still had no response, but Yan Xiaomiao always felt that the smile on his face seemed to be thicker, as if he agreed with what she said and thought that this brocade was very suitable for her.
"You think it looks good too, right?"
Yan Xiaomiao was even more happy now and held the brocade in her arms cherishingly. "So you have to get well quickly so that you can see me wear a red wedding dress to marry you again. Don't make me wait too long."
Standing outside the door, listening to Yan Xiaomiao talking to Qi Wuyong inside, Qi Wuyan's expression couldn't help but sink again and again, and like Qi Wuqiu, she felt a little confused in her heart.
Fortunately, it was broad daylight, otherwise Qi Wuyan would have thought that there was a ghost inside talking to her. When he heard his third brother describe her as being very good at talking to herself, he thought it was not such an exaggeration. But today...
Not only is it exaggerated, it’s almost terrifying!
"Huh? Second brother, why are you standing outside the door?"
Just when Qi Wuyan was secretly frightened, Yan Xiaomiao suddenly
He quickly straightened up his expression and said calmly: "I...I plan to go back to Buzhuang, so I stopped by to ask my fourth brother and sister if they think this brocade is good?"
"Okay, Wuyong and I like it very much!"
"..."
"Second brother, I'm going to trouble you with this Buzi."
Putting the brocade back into Qi Wuqiu's hands, Yan Xiaomiao was filled with a happy and sweet smile. "I'm looking forward to the moment when the wedding dress is made. I wonder when it will be ready?"
